capabilities: send selected text or the current line to a canvas as plain text, block link, or block embed
send the current note to a canvas as a note link or note embed
customize block IDs with date-based or MomentJS token formats
append timestamps and custom text to open tasks in sent content
configure canvas node sizes per node type and remember the last target canvas
extras: Full documentation is hosted on an external documentation site rather than in the README; the author solicits donations and GitHub stars.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas requires manually creating nodes and pasting content from notes, with no quick command to push existing text or notes onto a canvas.
summary: Canvas helper that sends selected text, blocks, or whole notes to a chosen Canvas file as plain text, links, or embeds.
